info.title: Accord Analytics API
info.description: Read API over the indexed Accord treasury data. This file is the contract for the HTTP endpoints: `cargo test -p accord-analytics-api openapi` fails whenever it drifts from the router or the parameter validation in `analytics-api/src/main.rs`. Written by hand; see docs/ANALYTICS_API.md.

200.description: The datastore answered within two seconds.

get.description: Per-dependency health used by the public status page. The overall status is `operational`, `degraded` or `outage`.

200.description: The service is operational or degraded.

get.description: Request, latency, rate-limit, cache and alert metrics in the Prometheus text format.

post.description: See the GraphQL section of docs/ANALYTICS_API.md.

200.description: A GraphQL response; execution errors are reported in `errors`.

400.description: The request was rejected by a safeguard.

429.description: The client exceeded its rate limit. See the `Retry-After` header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client may retry.

get.description: Follows every proposal created in the window through created → approved → executed, with cancelled (revoked) and expired proposals counted as the ways out. Each row is a cohort of proposals created in the window; rates are percentages (0–100). A proposal is approved once it reached its approval threshold, whatever became of it afterwards.

put.summary: Create or replace a workspace's report template
put.description: Replaces the whole template: a field left out returns to its default. The logo is referenced by https URL and printed in the PDF header, CSV and email; it is not embedded as an image. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>` when the deployment sets ADMIN_TOKEN.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: The contract whose template is written. Required when the deployment serves more than one contract; must be one of CONTRACT_IDS.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: The network whose template is written. Required when the deployment serves more than one network; must be one of NETWORKS.

400.description: A query parameter or body field is invalid, or the target workspace is ambiguous.

401.description: ADMIN_TOKEN is configured and the bearer token is missing or wrong.

413.description: The body is larger than 16 KiB.

brandName.description: Brand name printed above the report title.

sections.description: Sections to include, in order. Defaults to all four. In the PDF the transaction rows always follow the summary blocks.
